validation_scope: Local synthetic fixtures and frozen R25 source metadata only; no real cached replay, training, model forward, history construction, or data download.
verified_behaviors: Two real spawned workers finish ten synthetic source/learner groups using cached scores only.
Old budget rows match the original evaluator exactly; all original fixture files keep their SHA-256.
Sparse one-hour prefix waits for at least 399 strictly earlier rows; the entire switch-clock group is excluded.
Ready original-hour prefixes retain the original cutoff; insufficient blocks use old registered rules and report not_ready.
Exhaustive small-score examples validate strict-threshold oracle, integer normal budgets, ties, zero-normal unsupported cases and per-day scopes.
All rare target rows retain identities and available numeric features; original and repaired phases, service backgrounds and first-event time are checked.
Completed groups are excluded before creating a pool; repeated completed invocation creates no worker.
Missing one source score produces an incomplete package while the other source completes five groups.
Restoring the missing score under the same binding runs only five missing groups; earlier receipt digests and modification times are unchanged.
Worker count obeys available-memory and CPU limits; old cache relocation uses relative receipt members.
